newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs fall as NYMEX futures weaken.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs fall as NYMEX futures weaken.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices weakened on Wednesday amid lower NYMEX futures and few buyers ahead of the long July 4th weekend.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane fell a half cent, wiping out Tuesday's gain, to trade at 34.75 cents. Conway, Kansas, remained notional due to a lack of players.
Belvieu normal butane was down only slightly, with buyers at 40.00 cents and sellers at 40.50 cents, after jumping more than a penny Tuesday on short covering.
"I don't expect trade to pick up until Monday," said a trader in Houston.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
